user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point layer from EPSG:4326 to the census tract layer CRS, EPSG:26918.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector dataset to EPSG:26918 without changing its attributes or analytical meaning.

workflow_steps.title: Assign census tract identifiers to hospitals
workflow_steps.purpose: Join each hospital point to the census tract polygon that contains it and retain the tract GEOID with the hospital attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the reprojected hospital points and the census tract polygons. For each hospital, retain the attributes from the hospital layer and add the containing tract's GEOID as the tract identifier.

requirements.scope: The hospital and census tract inputs to assign_tract_geoid must use the same CRS before the spatial join executes.
